scene.label: Act 3, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Belmont. A room in Portia's house.
scene.location: Belmont. A room in Portia's house.

content.text: Enter Portia, Nerissa, Lorenzo, Jessica and Balthazar.

lines.text: Madam, although I speak it in your presence,
lines.plainText: Madam although I speak it in your presence

lines.text: You have a noble and a true conceit
lines.plainText: You have a noble and a true conceit

lines.text: Of godlike amity, which appears most strongly
lines.plainText: Of godlike amity which appears most strongly

lines.text: In bearing thus the absence of your lord.
lines.plainText: In bearing thus the absence of your lord

lines.text: But if you knew to whom you show this honour,
lines.plainText: But if you knew to whom you show this honour

lines.text: How true a gentleman you send relief,
lines.plainText: How true a gentleman you send relief

lines.text: How dear a lover of my lord your husband,
lines.plainText: How dear a lover of my lord your husband

lines.text: I know you would be prouder of the work
lines.plainText: I know you would be prouder of the work

lines.text: Than customary bounty can enforce you.
lines.plainText: Than customary bounty can enforce you

lines.text: I never did repent for doing good,
lines.plainText: I never did repent for doing good

lines.text: Nor shall not now; for in companions
lines.plainText: Nor shall not now for in companions

lines.text: That do converse and waste the time together,
lines.plainText: That do converse and waste the time together

lines.text: Whose souls do bear an equal yoke of love,
lines.plainText: Whose souls do bear an equal yoke of love

lines.text: There must be needs a like proportion
lines.plainText: There must be needs a like proportion

lines.text: Of lineaments, of manners, and of spirit;
lines.plainText: Of lineaments of manners and of spirit

lines.text: Which makes me think that this Antonio,
lines.plainText: Which makes me think that this Antonio

lines.text: Being the bosom lover of my lord,
lines.plainText: Being the bosom lover of my lord

lines.text: Must needs be like my lord. If it be so,
lines.plainText: Must needs be like my lord If it be so

lines.text: How little is the cost I have bestowed
lines.plainText: How little is the cost I have bestowed

lines.text: In purchasing the semblance of my soul
lines.plainText: In purchasing the semblance of my soul

lines.text: From out the state of hellish cruelty!
lines.plainText: From out the state of hellish cruelty

lines.text: This comes too near the praising of myself;
lines.plainText: This comes too near the praising of myself

lines.text: Therefore no more of it. Hear other things.
lines.plainText: Therefore no more of it Hear other things

lines.text: Lorenzo, I commit into your hands
lines.plainText: Lorenzo I commit into your hands

lines.text: The husbandry and manage of my house
lines.plainText: The husbandry and manage of my house

lines.text: Until my lord's return. For mine own part,
lines.plainText: Until my lord's return For mine own part

lines.text: I have toward heaven breath'd a secret vow
lines.plainText: I have toward heaven breath'd a secret vow

lines.text: To live in prayer and contemplation,
lines.plainText: To live in prayer and contemplation

lines.text: Only attended by Nerissa here,
lines.plainText: Only attended by Nerissa here

lines.text: Until her husband and my lord's return.
lines.plainText: Until her husband and my lord's return

lines.text: There is a monastery two miles off,
lines.plainText: There is a monastery two miles off

lines.text: And there we will abide. I do desire you
lines.plainText: And there we will abide I do desire you

lines.text: Not to deny this imposition,
lines.plainText: Not to deny this imposition

lines.text: The which my love and some necessity
lines.plainText: The which my love and some necessity

lines.text: Now lays upon you.
lines.plainText: Now lays upon you

lines.text: Madam, with all my heart
lines.plainText: Madam with all my heart

lines.text: I shall obey you in all fair commands.
lines.plainText: I shall obey you in all fair commands

lines.text: My people do already know my mind,
lines.plainText: My people do already know my mind

lines.text: And will acknowledge you and Jessica
lines.plainText: And will acknowledge you and Jessica

lines.text: In place of Lord Bassanio and myself.
lines.plainText: In place of Lord Bassanio and myself

lines.text: So fare you well till we shall meet again.
lines.plainText: So fare you well till we shall meet again

lines.text: Fair thoughts and happy hours attend on you!
lines.plainText: Fair thoughts and happy hours attend on you

lines.text: I wish your ladyship all heart's content.
lines.plainText: I wish your ladyship all heart's content

lines.text: I thank you for your wish, and am well pleas'd
lines.plainText: I thank you for your wish and am well pleas'd

lines.text: To wish it back on you. Fare you well, Jessica.
lines.plainText: To wish it back on you Fare you well Jessica

lines.text: Madam, I go with all convenient speed.
lines.plainText: Madam I go with all convenient speed

lines.text: Come on, Nerissa, I have work in hand
lines.plainText: Come on Nerissa I have work in hand

lines.text: That you yet know not of; we'll see our husbands
lines.plainText: That you yet know not of we'll see our husbands

lines.text: Before they think of us.
lines.plainText: Before they think of us

lines.text: Shall they see us?
lines.plainText: Shall they see us

lines.text: They shall, Nerissa, but in such a habit
lines.plainText: They shall Nerissa but in such a habit

lines.text: That they shall think we are accomplished
lines.plainText: That they shall think we are accomplished

lines.text: With that we lack. I'll hold thee any wager,
lines.plainText: With that we lack I'll hold thee any wager

lines.text: When we are both accoutered like young men,
lines.plainText: When we are both accoutered like young men

lines.text: I'll prove the prettier fellow of the two,
lines.plainText: I'll prove the prettier fellow of the two

lines.text: And wear my dagger with the braver grace,
lines.plainText: And wear my dagger with the braver grace

lines.text: And speak between the change of man and boy
lines.plainText: And speak between the change of man and boy

lines.text: With a reed voice; and turn two mincing steps
lines.plainText: With a reed voice and turn two mincing steps

lines.text: Into a manly stride; and speak of frays
lines.plainText: Into a manly stride and speak of frays

lines.text: Like a fine bragging youth; and tell quaint lies
lines.plainText: Like a fine bragging youth and tell quaint lies

lines.text: How honourable ladies sought my love,
lines.plainText: How honourable ladies sought my love

lines.text: Which I denying, they fell sick and died;
lines.plainText: Which I denying they fell sick and died

lines.text: I could not do withal. Then I'll repent,
lines.plainText: I could not do withal Then I'll repent

lines.text: And wish for all that, that I had not kill'd them.
lines.plainText: And wish for all that that I had not kill'd them

lines.text: And twenty of these puny lies I'll tell,
lines.plainText: And twenty of these puny lies I'll tell

lines.text: That men shall swear I have discontinued school
lines.plainText: That men shall swear I have discontinued school

lines.text: About a twelvemonth. I have within my mind
lines.plainText: About a twelvemonth I have within my mind

lines.text: A thousand raw tricks of these bragging Jacks,
lines.plainText: A thousand raw tricks of these bragging Jacks

lines.text: Which I will practise.
lines.plainText: Which I will practise

lines.text: Why, shall we turn to men?
lines.plainText: Why shall we turn to men

lines.text: Fie, what a question's that,
lines.plainText: Fie what a question's that

lines.text: If thou wert near a lewd interpreter!
lines.plainText: If thou wert near a lewd interpreter

lines.text: But come, I'll tell thee all my whole device
lines.plainText: But come I'll tell thee all my whole device

lines.text: When I am in my coach, which stays for us
lines.plainText: When I am in my coach which stays for us

lines.text: At the park gate; and therefore haste away,
lines.plainText: At the park gate and therefore haste away

lines.text: For we must measure twenty miles today.
lines.plainText: For we must measure twenty miles today
